rationale: FX01 is a row-level check on principal_amount_usd. The bundle shows eight flagged rows where principal_amount_usd is blank. The raw March 31, 2024 schedule contains corresponding non-USD debt principal rows, including EUR principal rows and GBP/SONIA principal rows, so a USD principal conversion is required for par analytics but was not extracted/populated. This is therefore a real extraction/normalization gap, not a false alarm.
